creatures.name: Silksurge
creatures.habitat: Mulberry Groves & Ancient Silk Valleys
creatures.education: Silkworms have been cultivated for over 5,000 years! A single caterpillar spins a continuous silk thread that can be over 3,000 feet long—longer than nine football fields! Ancient emperors kept the secret of silk production guarded on penalty of death.
creatures.exploration_trait: Silk Loom (Spins high-tensile silk threads used to craft luxury fabrics, gliders, and repair sails).
creatures.visual_notes: Plump velvety snow-white moth with feathery combed antennae and delicate cream silk wings.

creatures.name: Staghorn-Knight
creatures.habitat: Ancient Oak Woodlands & Deciduous Forests
creatures.diet: Sweet Oak Sap & Fallen Fruit Juice
creatures.education: The stag beetle is Britain and Europe's largest beetle! Male stag beetles have enormous antler-like jaws that look like the horns of a red deer stag. They use these antlers in medieval-style wrestling duels on tree branches, trying to flip rivals upside down!
creatures.exploration_trait: Antler Lever (Flips heavy fallen oak branches off hidden pathways).
creatures.visual_notes: Polished chestnut-brown wing cases with immense curved reddish-black pincer antlers.

creatures.name: Atlas-Titan
creatures.habitat: Subtropical & Tropical Forests of Asia
creatures.diet: Stored energy from caterpillar days (adults lack mouthparts)
creatures.education: The Atlas moth has one of the largest wingspans of any insect in the world (up to 12 inches)! The tips of its wings look and move exactly like the head of a venomous cobra snake. When threatened, the moth drops to the ground and slowly flaps its wings to mimic a striking cobra!
creatures.exploration_trait: Cobra Wing Mimic (Scares away woodland birds and curious predators with cobra-head wing tips).
creatures.visual_notes: Magnificent tawny-maroon wings with triangular transparent window panes and cobra-head wingtips.

creatures.name: Diving-Bell
creatures.habitat: Clean Vegetated Freshwater Ponds & Ditches
creatures.diet: Water Fleas, Mayfly Larvae, Tiny Minnows
creatures.education: The diving bell spider is the ONLY spider in the world that lives entirely underwater! It spins a silk dome among waterweeds, swims to the surface to trap air bubbles on its hairy belly, and carries the air down to fill its underwater silk diving bell balloon home!
creatures.exploration_trait: Oxygen Bubble Dome (Creates an underwater air pocket, extending the player's breath capacity while diving).
creatures.visual_notes: Silvery-velvet spider glistening with a trapped sphere of air clinging like liquid mercury to its abdomen.

creatures.name: Peacock-Wing
creatures.habitat: Pastures, Meadows & Stinging Nettle Beds
creatures.education: When resting with its wings closed, the peacock butterfly looks like a dead brown leaf. But if a bird pecks at it, it violently snaps open its wings to reveal four huge, hypnotic violet-and-blue eyespots and rubs its wings together to make a hissing screech heard by mice and birds!
creatures.exploration_trait: Hypnotic Eyespot (Stuns aggressive ambush beasts, freezing them in place for three seconds).
creatures.visual_notes: Velvety crimson-red wings adorned with large concentric eyespots of sapphire blue, gold, and midnight black.

creatures.name: Glow-Lantern
creatures.habitat: Chalk Grasslands, Hedgerows & Heathlands
creatures.education: The glow-worm is actually a beetle, not a worm! Wingless females climb up grass stalks on warm summer nights and curl their tails up into the air, shining a brilliant emerald-green bioluminescent beacon to attract winged males flying overhead.
creatures.exploration_trait: Beacon Lure (Plants a persistent glowing flare that marks pathways through disorienting misty swamps).
creatures.visual_notes: Slender segmented charcoal-brown beetle with tail segments glowing in pure, cold emerald starlight.

creatures.name: Fire-Mask
creatures.habitat: Linden Tree Bases & Sunny Garden Walls
creatures.education: Firebugs are famous for the geometric pattern on their backs, which looks like a dramatic African tribal mask or cartoon face! They gather in sunny clusters of hundreds of bugs around linden tree roots to share body warmth and warning colors.
creatures.exploration_trait: Mask Camouflage (Blends into warm red brick and terracotta homestead walls).
creatures.visual_notes: Graphic flat red-and-black bug sporting two bold black circles that form a laughing mask pattern.

creatures.name: Wood-Builder
creatures.habitat: Conifer & Mixed Ancient European Forests
creatures.diet: Honeydew, Pine Needle Resin, Forest Insects
creatures.education: Red wood ants build massive thatched dome mounds up to five feet tall made of millions of pine needles! To keep the nest warm in chilly spring weather, worker ants go outside, bask in the morning sun until their bodies heat up, and then carry that body heat inside like living hot water bottles!
creatures.exploration_trait: Thermal Thatch (Gathers fragrant pine needles and resin to insulate homestead roofs from winter cold).
creatures.visual_notes: Rust-red thorax with jet-black head and abdomen, powerful pincer jaws, and spiky pine needle tools.

creatures.name: Mole-Spade
creatures.habitat: Damp Meadows, Riverbanks & Organic Garden Soils
creatures.diet: Root Worms, Beetle Grubs, Plant Roots
creatures.education: The mole cricket is an incredible mechanical marvel of nature! Its front legs are transformed into broad spaded digging shovels that look exactly like the paws of a mammal mole! Males dig horn-shaped acoustic burrows that amplify their song so it sounds like a buzzing lawnmower.
creatures.exploration_trait: Sub-Sod Shovel (Digs subterranean irrigation ditches and uncovers buried clay pipes).
creatures.visual_notes: Velvety golden-brown insect with heavy armored spade forelegs and long delicate wing filaments.

creatures.name: Seven-Spot
creatures.habitat: Herb Meadows, Farmlands & Hedge Rows
creatures.education: In European folklore, ladybirds are considered lucky charms! The name 'ladybird' comes from 'Our Lady' Mary, and the seven black spots were said to represent her seven joys and sorrows. They are the farmer's best friend, devouring garden pests.
creatures.exploration_trait: Lucky Fortune (Increases the drop rate of rare seeds and sparkling crafting items from wild foliage).
creatures.visual_notes: Polished bright cherry-red dome wing covers stamped with exactly seven bold black spots.

creatures.name: Rose-Chafer
creatures.habitat: Rose Gardens, Sunny Shrublands & Compost
creatures.education: The rose chafer looks like a walking jewel! Its brilliant metallic green carapace can fly with its wing covers closed! It pops its clear flight wings out through tiny side notches under its shell, keeping its heavy armor locked in place for defense while airborne.
creatures.exploration_trait: Locked Armor Flight (Can fly through thorny rose briars and brambles without taking damage).
creatures.visual_notes: Glittering metallic emerald-and-gold carapace with fine white wavy cross-stripes and golden belly.

creatures.name: Hornet-Robber
creatures.habitat: Heathlands, Open Downlands & Pastures
creatures.education: The hornet robberfly is Britain's largest fly! It mimics a dangerous stinging hornet with a black-and-yellow striped belly to scare off birds. Despite having no stinger, it is a formidable hunter that catches prey in mid-air and injects quick digestive saliva.
creatures.exploration_trait: Aerial Interceptor (Guards the player's aerial gliders from hostile flying pests).
creatures.visual_notes: Large fuzzy golden-brown fly with yellow-and-black barred abdomen, spiny grasping legs, and clear wings.

creatures.name: Roman-Spiral
creatures.habitat: Chalky Lime Soils, Vineyards & Ancient Ruins
creatures.education: The Roman snail was spread across Europe by Roman legions who carried them as food! In winter, the snail seals its shell opening with a temporary chalky calcium door called an 'epiphragm' that keeps it cozy and warm until springtime.
creatures.exploration_trait: Chalk Masonry (Produces pure calcium lime mortar used to whitewash and fortify stone buildings).
creatures.visual_notes: Large globular creamy-buff spiral shell, gentle grey tentacles with curious eye stalks, and moist gliding foot.

creatures.name: Manna-Cicada
creatures.habitat: Mediterranean Olive Groves & Pine Hills
creatures.education: When the manna cicada feeds on flowering ash trees, sweet sugary sap leaks out and dries in the Mediterranean sun into white crystalline drops known as 'manna'! For centuries, local villagers harvested this sweet tree candy as a natural desert treat.
creatures.exploration_trait: Manna Harvest (Gathers sweet crystallizing sap from Mediterranean ash and olive trees).
creatures.visual_notes: Cryptic ash-gray bark-patterned body with clear crystalline wings spotted in black.

creatures.name: Emperor-Dart
creatures.habitat: Large Ponds, Lakes & Slow Marsh Rivers
creatures.education: The emperor dragonfly is one of Europe's largest dragonflies! It flies like a fighter jet, patrolling its territory for hours without ever landing. It can fly backwards, hover motionless, and calculate complex interception trajectories to catch prey mid-flight.
creatures.exploration_trait: Acrobatic Glide (Enables high-precision aerial maneuvers and hovering over water hazards).
creatures.visual_notes: Apple-green thorax with an intense electric sky-blue abdomen on males and iridescent four wings.

creatures.name: Deaths-Head
creatures.habitat: Potato Fields, Deciduous Woods & Apiaries
creatures.diet: Wild Honey raided directly from beehives
creatures.education: This famous moth has a yellow skull pattern on its back! It loves eating honey so much that it sneaks right into beehives: it produces a chemical scent that mimics bees so they don't sting it, and when touched, it can squeak loudly by blowing air out of its proboscis!
creatures.exploration_trait: Hive Infiltration (Allows the player to harvest wild honey from angry beehives without being stung).
creatures.visual_notes: Velvety dark chocolate wings, bumblebee-striped yellow-and-black abdomen, and a skull marking on the thorax.

creatures.name: Violin-Carapace
creatures.habitat: Shelf Fungi on Trees in Southeast Asian Rainforests
creatures.education: The violin beetle is shaped exactly like a tiny musical violin! Its body is paper-thin and flat, allowing it to slide into narrow microscopic cracks inside shelf mushrooms and rotting tree bark where no other insect can fit.
creatures.exploration_trait: Paper-Thin Crevice (Slips through narrow stone cracks to retrieve items locked behind iron bars).
creatures.visual_notes: Extremely flattened translucent brown body with violin-shaped flank flanges and needle-like neck.

creatures.name: Cinnabar-Silk
creatures.habitat: Coastal Dunes, Heathlands & Ragwort Pastures
creatures.education: Cinnabar caterpillars wear bright bumblebee warning stripes of yellow and black! They eat toxic ragwort plants, absorbing poisons into their own bodies so birds won't eat them. The adult moth is painted in striking charcoal gray and bright cinnabar scarlet.
creatures.exploration_trait: Toxin Absorption (Collects toxic botanicals safely without player poisoning).
creatures.visual_notes: Sleek slate-black forewings with crimson border stripes and two crimson dots, over bright scarlet hindwings.

creatures.name: Green-Huntsman
creatures.habitat: Damp Meadows, Moorlands & Oak Clearings
creatures.education: This is Europe's only green spider! Unlike tropical huntsman spiders that are grey or brown, this spider is bright vivid grass-green to blend into sunny meadow grasses. It doesn't spin webs; it hunts by stalking on foot like a tiny eight-legged leopard.
creatures.exploration_trait: Meadow Stealth (Grants total camouflage when walking through tall green grasses and grain fields).
creatures.visual_notes: Brilliant bright lime-green body with darker green dorsal stripe and long nimble running legs.

creatures.name: Camphor-Silk
creatures.habitat: Temperate East Asian Mountain Valleys
creatures.education: In ancient Japan and China, fishing lines and surgical thread were made from the ultra-strong silk glands of camphor moth caterpillars! Their silk cocoons are woven with an open mesh net structure that lets rain drain through so the pupa doesn't drown.
creatures.exploration_trait: Net Weave (Crafts mesh nets used for catching prize river fish and sifting gravel).
creatures.visual_notes: Earthy taupe-and-cream silk wings marked with distinct dark ring eyespots and delicate fringed margins.

creatures.name: Asian-Hornet
creatures.species: Asian Giant Hornet / Northern Giant Hornet
creatures.habitat: Low Mountain Forests & Subterranean Nests
creatures.diet: Tree Sap, Honey, Large Beetles, Mantises
creatures.education: The giant hornet is the largest hornet in the world, with a wingspan over three inches! Native Japanese honeybees have an ingenious defense: hundreds of bees swarm the invading hornet in a tight ball and vibrate their flight muscles to bake the hornet at 117°F!
creatures.exploration_trait: Thermal Ball Resistance (Resists intense environmental heat spikes inside volcanic caves).
creatures.visual_notes: Massive orange head with formidable black teeth, dark brown thorax, and gold-and-black striped abdomen.

creatures.name: Glow-Jewel
creatures.habitat: Warm Meadows & Berry Bushes
creatures.education: Jewel bugs are often called 'living gemstones' because an enlarged shield plate completely covers their back and wings, gleaming like polished enamel, gold, and sapphire! This hard shield shell makes them tough to crack for hungry songbirds.
creatures.exploration_trait: Jewel Polish (Polishes rough cut gems to increase their trade value with merchants).
creatures.visual_notes: Iridescent beetle-like shield gleaming in metallic peacock-blue, ruby, and gold leaf patterns.

creatures.name: Mantis-Euro
creatures.habitat: Sunny Meadows, Vineyards & Dry Grasses
creatures.education: The praying mantis is the ONLY insect on Earth that can turn its head 180 degrees over its shoulder to look behind itself! It has a single specialized ultrasonic ear located on its chest that lets it hear the sonar clicks of hunting bats in mid-air and dive out of the way.
creatures.exploration_trait: 180-Degree Scout (Alerts the player to stealth stalkers sneaking up from behind).
creatures.visual_notes: Slender apple-green mantis with spiny folded forelegs and two curious black spots under its armpits.

creatures.name: Bore-Beetle
creatures.habitat: Hardwood Maple, Willow & Birch Forests
creatures.education: Asian longhorned beetles have striking jet-black bodies with white spots and black-and-white banded antennae that are twice as long as their bodies! Their powerful larvae can bore deep through solid hardwood tree trunks.
creatures.exploration_trait: Hardwood Drill (Drills holes through timber and ancient wooden stockades).
creatures.visual_notes: Glossy piano-black body dotted with bright white splashes and sweeping blue-and-white ringed antennae.

creatures.name: Apis-Melli
creatures.habitat: Meadows, Orchards, Woodlands & Homestead Hives
creatures.education: To make one single pound of sweet golden honey, a colony of honeybees must fly over 55,000 miles and visit two million flowers! Inside the hive, hexagonal beeswax combs are the most mathematically efficient structures known to architecture.
creatures.exploration_trait: Hexagon Architecture (Reduces the timber and stone building costs of all hexagonal homestead structures).
creatures.visual_notes: Classic striped amber-and-black fuzzy bee with gossamer wings and bulging golden pollen baskets.

creatures.name: Cobrastrike
creatures.habitat: Dense Bamboo Thickets, Mangroves & Highland Forests
creatures.education: The king cobra is the longest venomous snake in the world, growing over 18 feet long! It can lift one-third of its entire body straight up off the ground and look a standing adult human directly in the eye while spreading its majestic hood and growling like a dog!
creatures.exploration_trait: Intimidation Hood (Expands hood to cow territorial wild beasts, preventing them from attacking).
creatures.visual_notes: Olive-bronze serpent with yellow-and-black chevron bands, wide flaring neck hood, and golden eyes.

creatures.name: Dragon-Komodo
creatures.habitat: Dry Tropical Savannas & Volcanic Scrub Islands
creatures.diet: Deer, Water Buffalo, Wild Pigs, Carrion
creatures.education: The Komodo dragon is the heaviest living lizard on Earth, weighing over 150 pounds! Underneath their skin is a layer of thousands of tiny bones called osteoderms that act like a suit of medieval chainmail armor! Their forked yellow tongue tastes the air to smell carrion from six miles away.
creatures.exploration_trait: Chainmail Hide (Grants high defense against piercing arrows and monster bites).
creatures.visual_notes: Massive muscular grey-brown monitor lizard with chainmail skin, long yellow forked tongue, and heavy tail.

creatures.name: Giga-Salamander
creatures.habitat: Cold Fast-Flowing Rocky Mountain Streams
creatures.diet: Freshwater Crabs, Fish, Frogs, Water Shrews
creatures.education: Growing over five feet long, this is the largest amphibian in the world! A living fossil that has survived unchanged for 170 million years, it makes vocal calls that sound like a crying baby or barking puppy, earning it the Chinese nickname 'wa wa yu' (baby fish)!
creatures.exploration_trait: Living Fossil Sense (Uncovers hidden fossil relics and ancient geological strata in riverbeds).
creatures.visual_notes: Enormous mottled slate-brown amphibian with loose wrinkled skin, tiny eyes, and paddle-like tail.

creatures.name: Fire-Spotted
creatures.habitat: Cool Deciduous European Beech Forests
creatures.education: Ancient folklore believed that fire salamanders were born inside blazing wood fires! This myth started because the salamanders hibernate inside rotting firewood logs; when peasants threw logs onto the hearth, the startled salamanders would crawl out of the ashes unscathed!
creatures.exploration_trait: Hearth Warmth (Prevents companion hypothermia and cures freezing debuffs around campfires).
creatures.visual_notes: Glossy midnight-black body painted with vivid, fiery canary-yellow warning blotches.

creatures.name: Viper-Zigzag
creatures.habitat: Heaths, Moorlands, Sunny Hillsides & Chalk Downland
creatures.diet: Field Mice, Voles, Lizards, Young Birds
creatures.education: The adder is the ONLY venomous snake native to Great Britain and lives farther north than any other snake, even above the Arctic Circle! Males do an athletic ritual combat called the 'dance of the adders,' intertwining their bodies like corkscrews to push each other down.
creatures.exploration_trait: Sub-Arctic Thermal (Permits cold-weather exploration in frost tundra without thermal penalties).
creatures.visual_notes: Silvery-grey male marked with an unbroken jet-black zigzag dorsal stripe and red ruby eyes.

creatures.name: Grass-Swimmer
creatures.habitat: Ponds, Canals, Wet Meadows & River Banks
creatures.education: The grass snake is an exceptional swimmer that hunts frogs underwater. When cornered by a fox, it plays dead in theatrical style: it rolls onto its back, lets its tongue hang limply out of its open mouth, and oozes a foul-smelling garlic musk from its tail!
creatures.exploration_trait: Garlic Musk Veil (Repels predatory foxes and canids from approaching the player).
creatures.visual_notes: Olive-green snake with a striking bright yellow-and-black collar neck ring and dark flank bars.

creatures.name: Gharial-Snout
creatures.habitat: Deep Fast-Flowing Sandbank Rivers of India
creatures.education: The gharial has an extremely long, slender snout lined with 110 razor-sharp interlocking teeth that snip through water with almost zero drag to catch darting fish! Mature males have a bulbous hollow growth on the tip of their snout called a 'ghara' that buzzes like a horn.
creatures.exploration_trait: Ghara Resonance (Blows air through its snout bulb to emit sound pulses that locate schools of fish).
creatures.visual_notes: Olive-tan crocodile with extraordinarily long needle snout, interlocking teeth, and bulbous pot on the nose.

creatures.name: Saltie-Colossus
creatures.habitat: Mangrove Swamps, Tidal Estuaries & Coastal Deltas
creatures.diet: Water Buffalo, Wild Boar, Mud Crabs, Fish
creatures.education: The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile on Earth! Huge males can weigh over 2,200 pounds and swim across hundreds of miles of open sea between tropical islands. Their bite force is the highest measured of any living creature (3,700 psi)!
creatures.exploration_trait: Tidal Ferry (Transports heavy cargo and player party across stormy ocean sounds).
creatures.visual_notes: Colossal muddy yellowish-tan armored titan with wide armored head and massive ridge-backed tail.

creatures.name: Wels-Titan
creatures.habitat: Deep Warm European Lakes & Slow Broad Rivers
creatures.diet: Fish, Frogs, Waterfowl, Pigeons on shore
creatures.education: The Wels catfish is one of the largest freshwater fish in the world, growing up to 10 feet long and weighing 300 pounds! In France, these clever giants were filmed beaching themselves like killer whales on river gravel to snatch land pigeons drinking water!
creatures.exploration_trait: Beaching Lunge (Lunges onto riverbank shores to grab lost resources without leaving water).
creatures.visual_notes: Mottled olive-black scaleless river giant with broad flat head, small eyes, and long whisker barbels.

creatures.name: Golden-Koi
creatures.habitat: Calm Lakes, Lotus Ponds & Slow Rivers
creatures.education: In Asian mythology, a humble carp that successfully leaps up the legendary Dragon Gate waterfall transforms into a mighty dragon! Historically bred for centuries as colorful living jewels, koi can live for over 100 years and recognize human voices.
creatures.exploration_trait: Dragon Gate Leap (Can leap up sacred mountain cascades to reach hidden hilltop shrines).
creatures.visual_notes: Gleaming scales of pure gold, platinum white, and vermilion with whisker barbels and fan fins.

creatures.name: Tokay-Bark
creatures.habitat: Tropical Rainforest Trees, Cliffs & Wooden Houses
creatures.education: The tokay gecko gets its name from its loud, ringing bark that echoes through the night: 'TO-KAY! TO-KAY!' They have millions of microscopic hairs on their toes that use molecular van der Waals forces to stick to polished glass ceilings without glue!
creatures.exploration_trait: Molecular Wall Stride (Scales smooth glass walls and vertical glazed tile surfaces).
creatures.visual_notes: Blue-gray lizard speckled with brilliant bright orange and red spots, huge golden vertical slit eyes.

creatures.name: Ocellated-Lizard
creatures.habitat: Mediterranean Scrub, Dry Stone Walls & Vineyards
creatures.diet: Beetles, Snails, Sweet Grapes, Small Mice
creatures.education: The ocellated lizard is the largest lizard in Europe, growing up to three feet long! Its flanks are adorned with brilliant turquoise-blue spots called 'ocelli' that look like precious sapphires set into emerald scale armor. It loves sunbathing on dry stone walls.
creatures.exploration_trait: Drystone Burrow (Slips into narrow gaps in ancient drystone walls to uncover hidden caches).
creatures.visual_notes: Vibrant emerald-and-black lizard with a large broad head and bright turquoise sapphire spots on its sides.

creatures.name: Steppe-Tortoise
creatures.habitat: Dry Central Asian Steppes & Rocky Deserts
creatures.education: In 1968, Russian tortoises became among the very first Earth creatures to travel to the Moon! The Soviet Zond 5 spacecraft carried tortoises around the moon and brought them safely back to Earth. In the wild, they dig burrows six feet deep to escape winter frost.
creatures.exploration_trait: Cosmic Orbit Burrow (Digs insulated subterranean bunkers that resist extreme seasonal weather).
creatures.visual_notes: Rounded olive-straw carapace with four stout clawed toes on each foot and calm wise face.

creatures.name: Bufo-Toad
creatures.habitat: Conifer & Hardwood Woods, Hedgerows & Garden Pools
creatures.education: Every spring, common toads undertake a perilous journey of several miles, returning to the exact same pond where they were born to lay long double strings of jelly eggs! They have glistening copper eyes with horizontal pupil slits.
creatures.exploration_trait: Homeward Compass (Always points the player toward the regional sanctuary homestead when lost).
creatures.visual_notes: Rough warty olive-brown skin with golden-copper eyes and thick dignified walking posture.

creatures.name: Cryo-Salamander
creatures.habitat: Siberian Taiga & Permafrost Marshes
creatures.education: The Siberian salamander can survive being frozen solid in Arctic permafrost at -40°F for years! Its blood contains natural biological antifreeze chemicals that replace water in its cells so ice crystals don't shatter them. When warm spring returns, it thaws and walks away!
creatures.exploration_trait: Permafrost Defrost (Immune to freezing and unthaws ancient frozen mechanisms in glacial ruins).
creatures.visual_notes: Glossy golden-bronze salamander with a dark dorsal stripe and wide rounded four-toed feet.

creatures.name: Crown-Crane
creatures.habitat: Freshwater Marshes, Deep Reeds & Snowy Rivers
creatures.education: In Japan and China, the red-crowned crane is a sacred symbol of luck, fidelity, and immortality! Pairs mate for life and perform breathtaking synchronized dances on snowy riverbanks, bowing, leaping into the air, and tossing sticks in celebration.
creatures.exploration_trait: Snow Dance (Increases companion bond growth and morale when resting in cold regions).
creatures.visual_notes: Pure snow-white plumage with black neck and flight feathers, crowned with a patch of bare red skin.

creatures.name: Golden-Pheasant
creatures.habitat: Dense Conifer & Bamboo Mountain Forests
creatures.diet: Leaves, Bamboo Shoots, Forest Berries, Spiders
creatures.education: The male golden pheasant is so brightly colored that ancient legends say it was the inspiration for the mythical Phoenix! His golden crest gleams like spun sunlight, and he fans out a striped orange cape around his face like a beautiful folding fan during displays.
creatures.exploration_trait: Phoenix Fan (Flashes brilliant cape feathers to illuminate dark bamboo forest trails).
creatures.visual_notes: Golden silk crest, fiery scarlet breast, orange-and-black striped cape, and long patterned tail feathers.

creatures.name: Bubo-Eagle
creatures.habitat: Rocky Mountain Cliffs, Deep Gorges & Taiga
creatures.diet: Hares, Foxes, Game Birds, Young Deer
creatures.education: The Eurasian eagle-owl is one of the largest owls in the world, with a wingspan of over six feet and talons as large as a golden eagle's! Its deep, resonant 'OOOH-hu' hoot can be heard echoing through mountain valleys up to three miles away on calm nights.
creatures.exploration_trait: Apex Night Watch (Detects all nocturnal roaming predators within a 500-meter radius).
creatures.visual_notes: Mottled tawny-buff plumage barred with black, upright feathered ear tufts, and fiery pumpkin-orange eyes.

creatures.name: Alcedo-Halcyon
creatures.habitat: Clean Clear Streams, Canals & Quiet Riverbanks
creatures.education: When Japanese engineers designed the supersonic Shinkansen bullet train, it made a deafening sonic boom when exiting tunnels. They redesigned the nose of the train to match the streamlined shape of the kingfisher's beak, making the train completely quiet and 10% faster!
creatures.exploration_trait: Bullet-Nose Dive (Pierces water surfaces with zero splash, guaranteeing rare fish catches).
creatures.visual_notes: Iridescent turquoise-cyan back with warm copper-chestnut belly, dagger bill, and coral-red feet.

creatures.name: Robin-Redbreast
creatures.habitat: Gardens, Hedgerows, Woodlands & Clearings
creatures.education: Robins have a special protein in their eyes called cryptochrome that lets them literally see the magnetic field lines of planet Earth! British gardeners love robins because they perch fearlessly beside spades, waiting to eat worms uncovered by digging.
creatures.exploration_trait: Gardener's Companion (Follows the player while digging, uncovering bonus seeds and earthworms).
creatures.visual_notes: Plump rounded olive-brown bird with bright orange-red breast bib and curious dark button eyes.

creatures.name: Lammergeier-Bone
creatures.habitat: High Mountain Crags, Alpine Peaks & Gorges
creatures.diet: Bones and Bone Marrow (up to 90% of diet!)
creatures.education: The bearded vulture is the ONLY animal in the world whose diet consists almost entirely of bone! If a bone is too big to swallow whole, it carries the bone high into the air and drops it onto flat rocks called 'ossuaries' to shatter it into bite-sized marrow pieces. They bathe in red iron dust to dye their feathers rust-orange!
creatures.exploration_trait: Ossuary Drop (Drops heavy rocks from heights to break sealed stone slabs on the ground).
creatures.visual_notes: Massive bird with pointed wings, wedge tail, black eye mask with a feathered goatee beard, and rust-orange chest.

creatures.name: White-Stork
creatures.habitat: River Floodplains, Wet Meadows & Village Roofs
creatures.education: In European folklore, white storks are famous for delivering newborn babies down chimneys! Villagers build wagon-wheel nesting platforms on their roofs because having a nesting stork pair is believed to bring good luck, happiness, and protection from lightning.
creatures.exploration_trait: Roof Chimney Fortune (Increases the sanctuary happiness and breeding speed of companions at the homestead).
creatures.visual_notes: Snow-white plumage with jet-black wing flight feathers, long coral-red bill, and stilt-like red legs.

creatures.name: Mute-Swan
creatures.habitat: Freshwater Lakes, Canals, Estuaries & Moats
creatures.education: The mute swan is one of the heaviest flying birds in the world! While called 'mute,' they hiss fiercely like a serpent to defend their cygnets. When flying overhead, their massive wingbeats make a loud musical singing whistle that can be heard miles away.
creatures.exploration_trait: Singing Wingbeat (Emits an acoustic whistle that clears mist and fog on water waterways).
creatures.visual_notes: Pristine snowy-white plumage, elegant S-curved neck, orange bill with black basal knob, and regal posture.

creatures.name: Mallard-Drake
creatures.habitat: Wetlands, Ponds, Rivers, Lakes & Flooded Parks
creatures.diet: Water Seeds, Aquatic Plants, Insects, Snails
creatures.education: The mallard is the ancestor of almost all domestic duck breeds! The drake's glossy green head feathers are iridescent, changing from emerald to deep violet depending on how light hits them. In winter, ducks keep their feet warm through counter-current heat exchange blood vessels!
creatures.exploration_trait: Pondweed Dabbler (Dabbles upside-down in shallow ponds to harvest submerged water seeds).
creatures.visual_notes: Glossy bottle-green head with white neck ring, chestnut breast, curling black tail feather, and orange feet.

creatures.name: Spotted-Chisel
creatures.habitat: Deciduous & Coniferous Woodlands & Orchards
creatures.education: Great spotted woodpeckers create an 'anvil' in tree bark! They wedge a hard pinecone into a tight crack in a tree trunk so they can peck out every nutritious pine nut without the cone rolling away. In spring, they drum on dead wood at 40 strikes per second to signal territory.
creatures.exploration_trait: Pinecone Anvil (Extracts high-nutrition pine nuts and seeds from collected conifer cones).
creatures.visual_notes: Piebald black-and-white plumage with crimson belly patch, scarlet nape badge on males, and chisel bill.

creatures.name: Cuckoo-Clock
creatures.habitat: Open Country, Moorlands, Marshes & Woodlands
creatures.diet: Hairy Caterpillars (which other birds can't eat)
creatures.education: The cuckoo is a master of trickery! It doesn't build its own nest; instead, the female lays an egg in the nest of another bird (like a meadow pipit) that looks exactly like the host's eggs. The arrival of the cuckoo's 'cuck-oo' call has marked the start of spring in Europe for millennia.
creatures.exploration_trait: Spring Arrival (Triggers early springtime blooms and awakens hibernating creatures).
creatures.visual_notes: Dove-like ash-gray bird with finely barred hawk-like chest and long graduated tail.

creatures.name: Jay-Acorn
creatures.habitat: Deciduous & Mixed Oak Woodlands
creatures.education: Eurasian jays are Europe's greatest tree planters! A single jay can bury up to 5,000 acorns in the forest floor every autumn as winter food stores. The thousands of forgotten acorns grow into Europe's oak forests! They also have electric-blue wing badge feathers.
creatures.exploration_trait: Oak Planter (Gathers and plants ancient oak seeds that grow into harvestable timber groves).
creatures.visual_notes: Warm pinkish-buff plumage with black-and-white barred crown crest and dazzling azure-blue wing panels.

creatures.name: Black-Neck-Crane
creatures.habitat: High Altitude Tibetan Plateau Alpine Bogs (10,000+ ft)
creatures.diet: Highland Plant Tubers, Barley, Small Frogs
creatures.education: The black-necked crane lives higher in the mountains than any other crane on Earth, nesting on remote high-altitude wetlands on the roof of the world in Tibet! Tibetan nomads revere the crane as a holy bird that brings auspicious weather and bountiful harvests.
creatures.exploration_trait: Plateau Blessing (Increases agricultural crop resistance to mountain frost and drought).
creatures.visual_notes: Ashy-gray body with velvety black neck and head, white eye patch, and bare red crown.

creatures.name: Peafowl-Fan
creatures.habitat: Deciduous Forests, Scrublands & Village Groves
creatures.diet: Seeds, Grains, Termites, Poisonous Small Snakes
creatures.education: The peacock's famous iridescent train contains over 200 tail covert feathers, each tipped with an iridescent shimmering 'eye' (ocellus)! When fanned out, the peacock shivers his feathers, producing low-frequency infrasound vibrations that humans can't hear but peahens feel!
creatures.exploration_trait: Infrasound Fan (Emits low-frequency vibrations that pacify agitated wildlife).
creatures.visual_notes: Radiant metallic cobalt-blue neck with a towering fan of emerald-and-gold feathers adorned with velvet eyespots.

creatures.name: Himalayan-Monal
creatures.habitat: Oak-Rhododendron Mountain Forests of the Himalayas
creatures.education: The Himalayan monal is called the 'nine-colored bird' in local folklore! Its iridescent plumage flashes metallic rainbow shades of copper, green, violet, indigo, and gold. It has a curved shovel-like bill that it uses to dig through deep mountain snow for alpine tubers.
creatures.exploration_trait: Alpine Snow Shovel (Digs through deep snowbanks to uncover buried high-altitude botanical herbs).
creatures.visual_notes: Breathtaking iridescent rainbow-plumaged pheasant with a peacock-like spoon feather crest and snowy rump.

creatures.name: Great-Hornbill
creatures.habitat: Mature Rainforest Canopies of Southeast Asia
creatures.education: The great hornbill has a massive yellow-and-black helmet called a 'casque' on top of its bill! In flight, its wings make a deep whooshing roar like a steam train because it lacks small underwing feathers, allowing air to rush between its flight feathers.
creatures.exploration_trait: Steam-Wing Gust (Blows away thick toxic spores and ground fumes with heavy wing gusts).
creatures.visual_notes: Colossal black-and-white hornbill with an enormous curved golden bill topped with a massive U-shaped horn casque.

creatures.name: Mandarin-Drake
creatures.habitat: Forested Mountain Rivers & Weeping Willow Lakes
creatures.diet: Water Seeds, Acorns, Snails, Small Fish
creatures.education: The mandarin duck is considered one of the most beautiful waterbirds on planet Earth! In Asian culture, pairs of mandarin ducks symbolize everlasting love and lifelong devotion because they are always seen swimming side by side in perfect harmony.
creatures.exploration_trait: Harmony Ripple (Guarantees double bond growth when traveling with paired companions).
creatures.visual_notes: Spectacular orange cheek whiskers, purple breast, and two upright golden 'sail' feathers on its back.

creatures.name: Nightingale
creatures.habitat: Dense Hazel Thickets, Hedgerows & River Woods
creatures.education: The nightingale's song is legendary in poetry and history! A single male nightingale can sing over 1,000 different complex musical syllables and tunes, singing late into the spring night when all other forest songbirds are asleep.
creatures.exploration_trait: Nocturnal Melody (Lulls hostile nocturnal creatures to sleep with gentle melodic song).
creatures.visual_notes: Plain warm russet-brown songbird with a warm chestnut tail and sweet clear throat.

creatures.name: Capercaillie
creatures.habitat: Ancient Scots Pine & Boreal Conifer Forests
creatures.education: The capercaillie is the largest grouse in the world—the size of a turkey! During spring courtship displays, males sing a bizarre song that sounds like corks popping from wine bottles followed by a rasping scythe, so loud that the bird goes temporarily deaf while singing!
creatures.exploration_trait: Conifer Forage (Harvests rich pine resin and aromatic spruce needle oils for salves).
creatures.visual_notes: Huge charcoal-slate woodland bird with metallic green breast shield, bright red eye crest, and fan tail.

creatures.name: Wallcreeper
creatures.habitat: Sheer Limestone Cliffs & Alpine Rock Gorges
creatures.diet: Spiders & Insects hiding in rock crevices
creatures.education: The wallcreeper lives on near-vertical mountain rock faces high in the Alps and Himalayas! Normally gray, every time it hops along a cliff it flicks open its rounded wings to flash startling crimson-and-white butterfly patterns against the gray stone.
creatures.exploration_trait: Cliff Crevice Pluck (Scales sheer vertical limestone cliffs to retrieve minerals and rare mosses).
creatures.visual_notes: Ash-gray mountain bird with long slender down-curved bill and magnificent rounded crimson wings.

creatures.name: Emberpanda
creatures.habitat: Highland Bamboo & Rhododendron Forests
creatures.education: The red panda was discovered and named 'panda' 50 years before the giant panda was! They have a specialized 'false thumb' (an enlarged wrist bone) that lets them grip bamboo stalks like a human hand. Their fluffy ringed tail doubles as a warm winter blanket!
creatures.exploration_trait: False-Thumb Bamboo Cut (Harvests whole bamboo timber stalks cleanly without tools).
creatures.visual_notes: Rusty-red fur coat, white whisker markings on face, black legs, and a thick ringed bushy tail.

creatures.name: Meles-Badger
creatures.habitat: Deciduous Hardwood Woodlands & Pastures
creatures.education: European badgers live in giant ancestral underground fortresses called 'setts' that have been used, expanded, and passed down by badger families for hundreds of years! Some badger setts have over 50 entrance doors and hundreds of meters of tunnels.
creatures.exploration_trait: Sett Engineering (Excavates multi-room underground shelter extensions at player homesteads).
creatures.visual_notes: Stout grey coat with distinctive black-and-white striped face, small rounded ears, and powerful claws.

creatures.name: Lutra-River
creatures.habitat: Clean Freshwater Rivers, Streams, Lochs & Coasts
creatures.education: The Eurasian otter has webbed feet and sensitive facial whiskers that detect the micro-vibrations of swimming fish in pitch-black river water! Their presence is a certified sign that a river's water is clean, pure, and free of pollution.
creatures.exploration_trait: Water Purity Pulse (Identifies pollution-free water sources that grant health regeneration).
creatures.visual_notes: Streamlined rich chocolate coat with cream throat bib, webbed paws, and long rudder tail.

creatures.name: Ermine-White
creatures.habitat: Moorlands, Woodlands, Hedgerows & Alpine Tundra
creatures.education: In winter, the stoat transforms into the 'ermine,' turning pure snow-white except for the jet-black tip of its tail! When hunting rabbits three times its size, it performs a mesmerizing acrobatic dance—flipping, rolling, and leaping—to hypnotize the rabbit!
creatures.exploration_trait: Hypnotic Weasel Dance (Distracts and disorients enemy groups with chaotic acrobatic flips).
creatures.visual_notes: Pristine snowy-white fur coat with a distinct jet-black tail tip in winter, rich brown and cream in summer.

creatures.name: Spikeling
creatures.habitat: Woodland Margins, Hedgerows, Meadows & Gardens
creatures.education: A European hedgehog has over 5,000 sharp hollow spines! When it smells a strange new scent, it chews it into a frothy white saliva paste and licks it all over its own spines in a curious behavior called 'self-anointing,' helping disguise its scent from predators.
creatures.exploration_trait: Self-Anoint Scent (Masks the player's scent with herbal pastes, preventing predator tracking).
creatures.visual_notes: Chubby rounded creature covered in cream-tipped brown spines, with an inquisitive snuffling snout.

creatures.name: Alpine-Marmot
creatures.habitat: High Alpine Meadows & Scree Slopes of the Alps
creatures.education: Alpine marmots spend up to nine months of the year hibernating in deep underground winter burrows, dropping their heart rate to just three beats per minute! When an eagle flies over high alpine meadows, the sentinel marmot lets out a piercing whistle that alerts all wildlife.
creatures.exploration_trait: Eagle Whistle Alarm (Instantly warns companions of swooping aerial predators).
creatures.visual_notes: Plump grizzled brown-and-fawn ground squirrel with dark cap, strong digging paws, and bushy tail.

creatures.name: Red-Tuft
creatures.habitat: Conifer Taiga & Mixed Scots Pine Woodlands
creatures.education: In winter, the Eurasian red squirrel grows magnificent, long ear tufts that stand up like feathery antennas! They can dry wild mushrooms by wedging them in tree forks before storing them in tree hollows for cold snowy winter days.
creatures.exploration_trait: Mushroom Dehydrator (Preserves wild mushrooms in tree forks into non-perishable travel rations).
creatures.visual_notes: Flame-red coat with snowy white belly, luxuriant bushy tail, and prominent feathery winter ear tufts.

creatures.name: Castor-Fiber
creatures.habitat: Forest Rivers, Canals, Sloughs & Wetlands
creatures.diet: Willow, Aspen, Birch Bark, Water Lilies
creatures.education: Eurasian beavers have a flatter head and narrower snout than their North American cousins. By building dams in European river valleys, they create wetlands that store fresh water, trap silt, clean pollution, and prevent flash flooding in nearby towns!
creatures.exploration_trait: Flood Barrier (Constructs water-retention dams that prevent river flooding during rainstorms).
creatures.visual_notes: Heavy-set waterproof reddish-brown rodent with chisel teeth and a scaly flat paddle tail.

creatures.name: Tanuki-Mask
creatures.habitat: Deciduous Forests, Bamboo Thickets & Streams
creatures.education: The tanuki looks like a raccoon, but it is an ancient wild member of the dog family! In Japanese folklore, the tanuki is a magical shapeshifter that brings good fortune and cheer. It is the ONLY wild dog species in the world that hibernates through the winter!
creatures.exploration_trait: Winter Slumber (Can enter restorative hibernation to recover from severe exhaustion states).
creatures.visual_notes: Plump fluffy canine with a grey-brown coat, black bandit facial mask, and short bushy tail.

creatures.name: Corsac-Fox
creatures.habitat: Semideserts & Eurasian Steppes of Central Asia
creatures.education: The corsac fox lives on the vast windy Eurasian steppes. Because water is so scarce on the dry steppes, it can get all the hydration it needs strictly from the food it eats and can go its entire life without drinking liquid water!
creatures.exploration_trait: Drought Endurance (Requires zero water supplies when crossing arid steppe biomes).
creatures.visual_notes: Pale silvery-gray coat with yellowish tones, white chin, and a fluffy black-tipped brush tail.

creatures.name: Tibetan-Square
creatures.habitat: High Altitude Tibetan Plateau Steppes (11,000+ ft)
creatures.education: The Tibetan sand fox has become an internet sensation because of its funny, perfectly rectangular face! Its cheek fur is extra thick and bushy to protect its neck from freezing Himalayan winds, giving it an adorably unimpressed, deadpan expression.
creatures.exploration_trait: Deadpan Focus (Completely immune to confusion, charm, and taunt battle debuffs).
creatures.visual_notes: Curious square-jawed head with thick cheek ruffs, sandy coat, narrow eyes, and bushy white-tipped tail.

creatures.name: Lynx-Euro
creatures.habitat: Boreal Forests, Carpathian Mountains & Taiga
creatures.education: The Eurasian lynx is the third-largest predator in Europe after the brown bear and wolf! Its triangular ear tufts act like mini antennas that improve its hearing, allowing it to pinpoint the sound of a roe deer crunching dry twigs 200 feet away.
creatures.exploration_trait: Antenna Ear Sentry (Detects large game herds moving through dense forest cover).
creatures.visual_notes: Muscular long-legged feline with spotted reddish-grey coat, prominent black ear tufts, and short tail.

creatures.name: Manul-Fluff
creatures.habitat: Rocky Montane Steppes of Central Asia
creatures.education: Pallas's cat has the densest and longest fur of any cat in the world! Its ears are set low and flat on the sides of its head so it can peek over mountain rocks without giving away its silhouette to alert pikas. Its pupils contract into small circles, not slits!
creatures.exploration_trait: Low-Profile Peek (Can peer over stone parapets and rocks without being detected by lookouts).
creatures.visual_notes: Extremely fluffy round silver-grey body, flat-set ears, circular pupils, and expressive grumpy face.

creatures.name: Wildcat-Felis
creatures.habitat: Broadleaved Deciduous Woods & Scrub Hills
creatures.education: The European wildcat looks like an extra-fluffy domestic tabby cat, but it has a thick blunt tail with distinct black rings and a solid black tip! It is completely untameable and fiercely independent, hunting silently through ancient oak forests.
creatures.exploration_trait: Ancient Stalk (Tracks through wild forest undergrowth without triggering rustling audio clues).
creatures.visual_notes: Sturdy tabby-patterned coat with broad head, green eyes, and a thick cylindrical blunt-tipped tail.

creatures.name: Stone-Marten
creatures.habitat: Rocky Hillsides, Deciduous Woods & Old Barns
creatures.education: The stone marten is famous for its curiosity and climbing agility! It has a distinct white bifurcated throat patch and can jump over six feet between tree branches and rock ledges with effortless grace.
creatures.exploration_trait: Acrobatic Beam Walk (Can walk across narrow suspension cables and crumbling stone beams).
creatures.visual_notes: Long slender dark brown body with a bifurcated white chest patch and agile climbing claws.

creatures.name: Sable-Velvet
creatures.habitat: Dense Siberian Taiga & Spruce-Cedar Forests
creatures.diet: Chipmunks, Voles, Pine Nuts, Cedar Berries
creatures.education: The sable's lustrous fur coat is so soft and warm that it was historically known as 'soft gold'! Unlike other mustelids, sables rely heavily on rich Siberian pine nuts in winter, caching thousands of nuts inside tree hollows.
creatures.exploration_trait: Pine Nut Cache (Uncovers hidden winter caches of nutrient-rich Siberian pine nuts).
creatures.visual_notes: Glossy luxurious dark brown fleece coat with pale fawn throat patch and sharp inquisitive eyes.

creatures.name: Polecat-Mask
creatures.habitat: River Margins, Wet Woodlands & Marshland Edges
creatures.education: The European polecat is the wild ancestor of the domestic pet ferret! It has an ingenious hunting trick: in winter, it caches dozens of paralyzed frogs and toads in safe mud chambers so it has fresh food throughout freezing weather.
creatures.exploration_trait: Living Larder (Stores fresh amphibious forage in camp larders without spoiling).
creatures.visual_notes: Dark brown guard hairs over yellow underfur, with a white raccoon-like mask across its snout and ears.

creatures.name: Warren-Rabbit
creatures.habitat: Dry Sandy Grasslands, Scrublands & Dunes
creatures.diet: Grass Shoots, Clovers, Roots, Tree Bark
creatures.education: The European rabbit is the ancestor of all 300+ breeds of domestic pet rabbits! Unlike hares that live solitary lives above ground, rabbits live in enormous communal underground cities called 'warrens' with dozens of interconnected burrows.
creatures.exploration_trait: Warren Network (Unlocks fast-travel shortcut warrens between connected regional camps).
creatures.visual_notes: Soft grey-brown fur with buff underparts, long alert ears, and white powder-puff tail.

creatures.name: Siberian-Glider
creatures.habitat: Boreal Taiga with Old Aspen & Spruce Groves
creatures.diet: Birch Catkins, Pine Seeds, Alder Cones
creatures.education: The Siberian flying squirrel has giant, soulful midnight-black eyes that look like anime characters! It glides between taiga trees on a furry membrane, landing with a soft thud on the far side of a tree trunk before instantly scurrying around to hide from owls.
creatures.exploration_trait: Taiga Canopy Glide (Glides silently between tall boreal spruce towers across impassable ravines).
creatures.visual_notes: Silvery-gray plush fur ball with giant dark button eyes and a flattened balancing tail.

creatures.name: Chamois-Surefoot
creatures.habitat: Steep Alpine Cliffs, Scree Slopes & Alpine Meadows
creatures.education: The chamois is an agile goat-antelope capable of jumping over six feet high and fourteen feet across rocky mountain chasms! Their hooves have rubbery elastic soles that grip wet, slippery limestone rock like specialized rock climbing shoes.
creatures.exploration_trait: Surefoot Scree (Mount that sprints across loose mountain shale and gravel without sliding).
creatures.visual_notes: Tawny-brown coat in summer (dark brown in winter) with white facial stripes and slender hooked horns.

creatures.name: Tigrispark
creatures.habitat: Russian Far East Taiga & Korean Pine Forests
creatures.diet: Wild Boars, Red Deer, Elk, Brown Bears
creatures.education: The Siberian tiger is the largest big cat in the world, weighing up to 660 pounds! To survive harsh Siberian winters with temperatures dropping to -50°F, it has a layer of fat on its belly up to two inches thick and dense winter fur twice as long as tropical tigers.
creatures.exploration_trait: Apex Frost Roar (Freezes territorial beasts in terror and shatters frozen ice blockades).
creatures.visual_notes: Colossal tiger with golden-orange fur, wide black stripes, massive paws, and thick frost mane.

creatures.name: Bengal-Radiance
creatures.habitat: Sundarbans Mangroves & Dry Deciduous Forests
creatures.diet: Chital Deer, Sambar, Gaur, Wild Boar
creatures.education: A Bengal tiger's roar can be heard over two miles away and can reach a deafening 114 decibels! In the Sundarbans mangrove swamps, Bengal tigers are magnificent swimmers that easily cross wide, salty ocean river mouths over five miles wide.
creatures.exploration_trait: Mangrove Stride (Plows through tangled mangrove roots and swamp waters without penalty).
creatures.visual_notes: Muscular athletic tiger with rich reddish-gold coat, sharp black stripes, and fiery amber eyes.

creatures.name: Pandaboo
creatures.habitat: Misty Bamboo Mountain Forests of Central China
creatures.diet: Bamboo (up to 84 lbs every single day!)
creatures.education: Giant pandas spend up to 14 hours every day chewing bamboo! They have an enlarged wrist bone called a 'pseudo-thumb' that functions like an opposable thumb to grip bamboo stems. In Chinese culture, pandas are cherished global ambassadors of peace and friendship.
creatures.exploration_trait: Bamboo Bulldozer (Clears dense bamboo thickets, creating open walking trails for companions).
creatures.visual_notes: Plump adorable black-and-white bear with round black ears, black eye patches, and peaceful posture.

creatures.name: Snowprowl
creatures.habitat: Rugged Alpine Cliffs of the Himalayas (9,000–18,000 ft)
creatures.education: Known as the 'ghost of the mountains,' the snow leopard is so elusive it is rarely seen! It has an extraordinarily thick tail as long as its entire body that it wraps around its face like a warm woolly scarf to stay warm while sleeping through blizzard winds.
creatures.exploration_trait: Ghost of the Crags (Leaps across 50-foot mountain ravines and moves unseen across snowy scree).
creatures.visual_notes: Smoky-gray coat with dark rosette rings, wide furry snowshoe paws, and an enormous fluffy tail.

creatures.name: Elephas-Sage
creatures.habitat: Dry Thorn Forests, Grasslands & Tropical Rainforests
creatures.diet: Grass, Bamboo Shoots, Tree Bark, Bananas
creatures.education: Asian elephants have a single prehensile 'finger' on the tip of their trunk (African elephants have two), allowing them to grasp delicate herbs with incredible finesse! They have smaller rounded ears and have worked alongside human civilizations for thousands of years.
creatures.exploration_trait: Ancient Timber Haul (Lifts and moves heavy ancient stone pillars and logs at homestead builds).
creatures.visual_notes: Noble slate-gray elephant with twin dome bulges on its forehead, pink ear speckles, and curved tusks.

creatures.name: Unicornis-Rhino
creatures.habitat: Tall Riverine Grasslands & Swamp Alluviums
creatures.diet: Tall Elephant Grasses, Water Reeds, Aquatic Flora
creatures.education: The Indian rhinoceros looks like it is wearing an impenetrable suit of armor! Its skin forms heavy folded plates studded with wart-like tubercles that resemble rivets on medieval plate mail. It is a fantastic swimmer and can run at 35 miles per hour!
creatures.exploration_trait: Platemail Ram (Crushes through reinforced steel-banded fortress gates and iron portcullises).
creatures.visual_notes: Colossal silver-brown armored behemoth with thick plate skin folds and a single sharp horn.

creatures.name: Ursus-Eurasia
creatures.habitat: Taiga, Conifer & Deciduous Forests of Eurasia
creatures.diet: Berries, Roots, Fungi, Honey, Salmon, Ungulates
creatures.education: The Eurasian brown bear has been revered in European heraldry and folklore for centuries as the 'King of the Forest.' They have incredible memory, remembering the location of fruitful blueberry patches and beehives for decades.
creatures.exploration_trait: Berry-Path Memory (Maps out the locations of all fruitful berry and nut bushes in a region).
creatures.visual_notes: Dense brown coat with prominent muscular shoulder hump and powerful rounded skull.

creatures.name: Howlwind
creatures.habitat: Taiga, Temperate Broadleaf Forests & Steppes
creatures.diet: Wild Boars, Red Deer, Roe Deer, Elk
creatures.education: Eurasian wolves have narrower muzzles and shorter, denser fur than North American wolves. A wolf pack's territory can cover over 400 square miles, which they patrol continuously, communicating through haunting multi-harmonic howling choruses.
creatures.exploration_trait: Territorial Howl (Claims wilderness sectors, preventing roaming monsters from respawning in camps).
creatures.visual_notes: Sleek tawny-gray coat with dark saddle mantle, sharp triangular ears, and piercing yellow eyes.

creatures.name: Hornswirl
creatures.habitat: Open Steppes & Semideserts of Central Asia
creatures.education: The saiga antelope has a bizarre, flexible bulbous snout like a miniature elephant trunk! This inflatable nose filters out choking dust kicked up during summer herd stampedes and warms up freezing sub-zero winter air before it reaches the lungs!
creatures.exploration_trait: Dust-Filter Snout (Protects the player from choking dust storms and toxic volcanic smoke).
creatures.visual_notes: Sandy-cinnamon antelope with an oversized downward-drooping snout and translucent amber spiral horns.

creatures.name: Przewalski-Wild
creatures.habitat: Dry Steppes & Semideserts of Mongolia
creatures.education: The Takhi is the ONLY truly wild horse species surviving on Earth today (all other wild horses are feral descendants of domestic horses)! They have 66 chromosomes (domestic horses have 64) and brandish an upright, spiky mohawk mane that never falls over.
creatures.exploration_trait: True Wild Gallop (High-endurance mount that never suffers saddle fatigue or terrain penalties).
creatures.visual_notes: Stocky dun-colored horse with pale muzzle, dark zebra-striping on legs, and erect dark mohawk mane.

creatures.name: Sandhump
creatures.habitat: Gobi Desert & Arid Shifting Dunes of Central Asia
creatures.diet: Salty Shrubs, Desert Thorns, Dry Grasses
creatures.education: Wild Bactrian camels have two humps packed with fat (not water!) that can sustain them for weeks without food. They are the only land mammals on Earth capable of drinking bitter salt water and slush salt water that would kill any other animal!
creatures.exploration_trait: Brine Drinker (Can safely consume and purify bitter salty water from saline desert springs).
creatures.visual_notes: Sturdy sandy-brown camel with two conical woolly humps, split double eyelashes, and calm desert gaze.

creatures.name: Wisent-Ancient
creatures.habitat: Primeval Deciduous & Mixed Białowieża Forests
creatures.diet: Tree Bark, Acorns, Shrubs, Forest Ferns
creatures.education: The wisent is Europe's heaviest surviving native land mammal! Standing taller than the American bison, they are browsers that thrive in primeval ancient forests like the Białowieża forest in Poland. Once extinct in the wild in 1927, they were saved from zoo herds!
creatures.exploration_trait: Primeval Trailblazer (Smashes through tangled ancient forest deadfall to forge direct travel paths).
creatures.visual_notes: Tall, stately dark-brown bison with longer legs, smaller shoulder hump, and forward-curved horns.

creatures.name: Red-Stag
creatures.habitat: Deciduous Woodlands, Highland Moors & Forests
creatures.education: The monarch of the European glen! Mature stags grow magnificent multi-pointed antlers crowned with a cup or 'crown' of points. During the autumn rut, their deep guttural roaring bellows echo across misty heather moors.
creatures.exploration_trait: Crown Antler Herald (Inspires all party companions, boosting their offensive strength).
creatures.visual_notes: Noble stag with rich reddish-brown coat, dark neck mane, and a towering crown of branched antlers.

creatures.name: Markhor-Spiral
creatures.habitat: Rugged Scrub Cliffs of the Karakoram & Hindu Kush
creatures.diet: Grasses, Leaves, Twigs, Wild Pine Needles
creatures.education: The markhor is the national animal of Pakistan! The name means 'snake eater' in Persian folklore. Males brandish breathtaking spiral corkscrew horns that can grow over five feet long—the most spectacular horns in the goat kingdom!
creatures.exploration_trait: Corkscrew Ram (Shatters spiral geological rock formations and opens mountain paths).
creatures.visual_notes: Magnificent wild goat with long flowing white chest mane and towering flared corkscrew spiral horns.

creatures.name: Snow-Sheep
creatures.habitat: Subarctic Volcanic Mountains of Kamchatka & Siberia
creatures.education: Siberian snow sheep live on active volcanic peaks and frozen scree slopes in the Russian Far East. Their dense fleece traps warm air against their skin, keeping them cozy even when icy Pacific gale winds blow across Kamchatka's glaciers.
creatures.exploration_trait: Volcanic Scree Stride (Scales hot volcanic rock slopes and icy scree without footing loss).
creatures.visual_notes: Stout greyish-brown mountain ram with thick curled horns, white muzzle patch, and frost-resistant fleece.

creatures.name: Takin-Golden
creatures.habitat: Steep Bamboo Valleys & Crags of Qinling Mountains
creatures.education: The golden takin is believed to be the real-life source of the mythical 'Golden Fleece' sought by Jason and the Argonauts! Covered in a thick, lustrous coat of pure golden-honey fleece, this bizarre beast looks like a cross between a goat, an antelope, and a bear!
creatures.exploration_trait: Golden Fleece Radiance (Reflects light into darkened mountain ruins to illuminate puzzle switches).
creatures.visual_notes: Heavy muscular creature blanketed in shimmering golden-cream fleece with swept-back gnu-like horns.

creatures.name: Wild-Yak
creatures.habitat: High Altitude Tibetan Plateau Tundra (14,000–20,000 ft)
creatures.education: Wild yaks live higher in the mountains than almost any other mammal! They have enlarged lungs, three times more red blood cells than lowland cattle to breathe thin mountain air, and a thick skirt of shaggy fleece that hangs almost to the ground to keep their bellies warm on frozen ice.
creatures.exploration_trait: High-Altitude Oxygen (Provides the player with oxygen protection at high mountain altitudes).
creatures.visual_notes: Towering black-brown bovine with massive sweeping curved horns and a flowing skirt of shaggy fleece.

creatures.name: Clouded-Neofelis
creatures.habitat: Deep Tropical Rainforests of Borneo & Sumatra
creatures.education: The clouded leopard has the longest canine teeth relative to body size of any living carnivore—the modern world's closest living relative to saber-toothed cats! It can climb down tree trunks headfirst and hang upside down from branches by its hind paws.
creatures.exploration_trait: Saber-Bough Leap (Drops silently from high canopy limbs for devastating surprise ambushes).
creatures.visual_notes: Sleek cat patterned with cloud-like grey-and-black patches, large paws, long tail, and long saber fangs.

creatures.name: Cobra-Sovereign
creatures.habitat: Ancient Himalayan Monastery Ruins & Sacred Groves
creatures.education: Ancient elder king cobras guarding remote temple shrines are revered in Asian mythology as the Naga kings—protectors of sacred water springs and ancient knowledge. Their hypnotic hood flare can entrance entire hostile raiding parties.
creatures.exploration_trait: Naga Sanctuary Ward (Establishes sacred water zones where hostile monsters cannot enter).
creatures.visual_notes: Immense golden serpent spanning 20 feet with glowing solar glyphs along its magnificent hood.

creatures.name: Taiga-Sovereign
creatures.habitat: Primeval Heart of the Sikhote-Alin Mountains
creatures.education: In the indigenous Udege folklore of the Russian Far East, the elder Amur tiger is 'Amba'—the guardian spirit of the northern forests. It rules the frozen taiga with quiet majesty, walking like a ghost across snowy ridges.
creatures.exploration_trait: Taiga Master (Grants permanent cold immunity, maximum travel speed, and respect from all northern beasts).
creatures.visual_notes: Monumental elder tiger crowned by a silver frost mane, gleaming sapphire-blue eyes, and deep majestic stripes.
